description: DeSciX Cloud Service Configuration Schema - Defines key categories for bootstrap and dev override

bootstrap_keys.description: Keys loaded from .env/.yaml BEFORE Secret Manager access (required for bootstrap)

boolean_keys.description: Keys that should be parsed as boolean (value === 'true')

dev_override_keys.description: Keys that can be overridden via .env or dev-overrides.json in dev for pre-testing before Secret Manager deployment

defaults.description: Keys with safe default values (use sparingly - prefer null to expose config errors)
